title: Add local UI kit and replace missing shadcn/ui imports to restore frontend build

requirements.summary: Replace all `@/components/ui/*` imports in `frontend/src` with imports from a new local UI kit prefix (e.g. `@/components/ui-kit/*`) without touching the immutable `frontend/src/components/ui` path.
acceptanceCriteria: No source file in `frontend/src` imports from `@/components/ui/*` anymore.
The app compiles without unresolved-import errors for UI components.
All updated imports use a consistent new prefix (e.g. `@/components/ui-kit/...`).

requirements.summary: Implement a local, non-immutable UI kit that provides the same exports and subcomponents currently used by the app for button/card/badge/alert/dialog/alert-dialog/input/label/textarea/select/radio-group with Tailwind styling supporting light/dark mode.
acceptanceCriteria: All pages/components that previously depended on Shadcn-style UI primitives render without runtime crashes.

The newly added UI components provide the specific exports used in files like `frontend/src/components/transactions/TransactionFormDialog.tsx`, `frontend/src/components/vendors/DeleteVendorGuard.tsx`, and `frontend/src/pages/TransactionsPage.tsx` (e.g. `Dialog`, `DialogContent`, `AlertDialogAction`, `SelectTrigger`, `RadioGroupItem`, etc.).
UI components apply Tailwind classes so existing className usage in the app continues to produce a usable layout in both light and dark mode.

file_operations.description: Add shared UI-kit utilities (e.g., a `cn(...)` className combiner) used across UI primitives to match shadcn-style ergonomics while keeping Tailwind class composition intact. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create `Button` with shadcn-like props (`variant`, `size`, `asChild`-style compatibility if needed) and Tailwind classes compatible with existing usages across pages/dialogs. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create `Card` and subcomponents `CardHeader`, `CardTitle`, `CardDescription`, `CardContent`, `CardFooter` with Tailwind styling consistent with current layout usage. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create `Badge` with `variant` support (at least `default` and `secondary`) to match current usage and Tailwind theme variables. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create `Alert` and `AlertDescription` (and `AlertTitle` if helpful) with a `variant` option (including `destructive`) to match current guards and error states. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create `Dialog` primitives and exports used by the app (`Dialog`, `DialogContent`, `DialogHeader`, `DialogTitle`, `DialogDescription`, `DialogFooter`) with accessible structure and Tailwind classes so existing dialog pages render correctly. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create `AlertDialog` primitives and exports used by the app (`AlertDialog`, `AlertDialogContent`, `AlertDialogHeader`, `AlertDialogTitle`, `AlertDialogDescription`, `AlertDialogFooter`, `AlertDialogAction`, `AlertDialogCancel`) with Tailwind styling and compatible props. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create `Input` as a styled input primitive (supports `type`, `required`, `min`, `step`, etc.) and forwards refs/props as needed by existing forms. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
Create `Label` as a styled label primitive supporting `htmlFor` and className merging consistent with current form usage. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create `Textarea` as a styled textarea primitive supporting `rows`, value/onChange, and className merging used in person/vendor/transaction forms. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create `Select` primitives and exports used by the app (`Select`, `SelectTrigger`, `SelectValue`, `SelectContent`, `SelectItem`) to support the current controlled `value`/`onValueChange` patterns with Tailwind styling. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create `RadioGroup` and `RadioGroupItem` exports to support controlled selection (`value`/`onValueChange`) as used in the transaction type selector with Tailwind styling. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Remove the missing `@/components/ui/sonner` wrapper and mount a working toaster once at the app root while keeping existing `toast.success`/`toast.error` calls functional.
acceptanceCriteria: A toaster is mounted once at the app root, and existing calls like `toast.success('...')` still display notifications.

file_operations.description: Replace `import { Toaster } from '@/components/ui/sonner'` with a working `Toaster` import (e.g., from `sonner`) and keep a single `<Toaster />` mounted under the app root so existing `toast.success`/`toast.error` calls continue to work. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
